messages.content:
Receipt Extraction Rules:
1. PAYMENT VS CHARGES: Ignore TUNAI or CASH because that is the money paid by the customer, not subtotal, discounts, or grand_total. Ignore KEMBALI or KEMBALIAN because that is the change returned, not tax or grand_total. The number next to QTY is the total item count, not service_charge. If there's the word PCS after an item's name, it is part of the item's name not the quantity.
2. TAX (tax): Set tax to 0 if the receipt does not explicitly show the word PAJAK %, PPN %, or PB1 %. Tax MIGHT have percentage next to it.
3. SERVICE CHARGE (service_charge): Set service_charge to 0 if the receipt does not explicitly show SERVICE or LAYANAN.
4. DISCOUNTS (discounts): Set discounts to 0 if the receipt does not explicitly show DISKON or POTONGAN.
5. NUMBER FORMAT: Dots are thousand separators and commas are decimals. Convert formats like 26.000,00 into a plain integer 26000.
6. TOTALS: If tax, service_charge, and discounts are 0, grand_total must equal subtotal. 
7. ITEM ID (id): Fill each of the id field with integer starting from 1 to each items.
 Some info that might be useful: Read the items from top to bottom.

content.text: Extract the items and totals from this receipt.

merchant_name.description: Nama toko atau merchant di bagian paling atas struk.

id.description: The id of each items such as (1, 2, 3, 4, ...)

qty.description: Jumlah/kuantitas barang yang dibeli (biasanya angka setelah huruf 'x').

price.description: Harga satuan per item (biasanya angka sebelum huruf 'x').

total.description: Total harga baris (angka setelah tanda sama dengan '=').

tax.description: Pajak (PPN/PB1). WAJIB 0 jika tidak ada tulisan Pajak/PPN/PB1 pada struk.

service_charge.description: Biaya layanan. WAJIB 0 jika tidak tertulis Service Charge di struk.

discounts.description: Potongan harga. WAJIB 0 jika tidak ada baris diskon.

grand_total.description: Total tagihan bersih yang wajib dibayar (bukan uang tunai yang diserahkan).
